description: This Java class defines a conditional configuration class 'StorageServiceCondition' that enables or disables a storage service based on the 'storage.type' property. It implements Spring's 'Condition' interface to evaluate the condition during application context initialization, checking whether the current storage type matches a specified qualifier value.

classes.name: StorageServiceCondition
classes.description: A conditional class that activates storage services based on the 'storage.type' property in the environment, enabling default 'local' storage if none is specified.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current environment's 'storage.type' property matches the qualifier value provided to the annotation, dictating whether storage features should be enabled.
